cooperatives.title: Cooperatives

cooperatives.tableCaption: Cooperatives on the platform, with status, location and staff numbers.

restore.title: Restore {{name}}?
restore.body: Its staff can sign in again and carry on where they left off.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.body: The records are kept for reference but the cooperative is closed for good. Deactivate the remaining staff first.

form.title: New cooperative
form.description: The cooperative and its first manager are created in one step.

form.typesError: We could not load the cooperative types. Close this and try again.

fieldErrors.code: Use capital letters, digits and hyphens only, starting with a letter.
fieldErrors.managerEmail: Write a valid email address for the manager.

created.withAccount: {{name}} is ready. We sent {{email}} a link for setting a password.
created.existingAccount: {{name}} is ready. {{email}} already had an account and is now its manager.

users.title: People using the platform
users.description: Every account, the cooperatives it belongs to, and who may administer the platform.
users.tableCaption: Accounts on the platform, with status, platform rights and cooperative memberships.

self.reason: You cannot change your own access. Ask another platform administrator to do it.

empty.body: Create the first account so somebody can sign in to the platform.

noResults.title: Nobody matches these filters
noResults.body: Try another search, or clear the filters to see everybody again.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.body: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in again until you restore the account.

restore.title: Restore {{name}}?
restore.body: They can sign in again with the password they already have.

grantAdmin.title: Give {{name}} platform rights?
grantAdmin.body: They will be able to create cooperatives and accounts, and to suspend them, across the whole platform.

revokeAdmin.title: Withdraw platform rights from {{name}}?
revokeAdmin.body: They keep their cooperative work but lose every platform screen.

form.title: New user
form.description: The account is created without a password; we send a link for setting one.

fields.emailHint: The link for setting a password goes here.
fields.platformAdminHint: Give this only to the few people who look after the whole platform.

users.created: {{name}} can now set a password using the link we sent to {{email}}.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.description: The settings that apply to the whole platform rather than to one cooperative.

panel.title: New cooperatives
panel.description: What a cooperative gets when it is created.
